_about: Sized for about 10 people working at once on one dedicated server (8 cores/16 threads, 64 GB RAM): 10 browsers running at most, 720p at 25 fps to save CPU and office bandwidth. Change 'tools' to the shared accounts you actually have; every browser number is unique and opens WebRTC port 59100 + number (UDP and TCP). See deploy/WORKSPACE.md.
token: REPLACE with: openssl rand -hex 32  (the same value goes in the gateway's GATEWAY_WORKSPACE_AGENT_TOKEN)
public_ip: REPLACE with this server's public IP address
gateway_ip: REPLACE with the gateway server's IP address (only it may reach the agent)
